items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee refers to Snub Mosley as 'Her husband' (the interviewer's former wife's husband) and mentions he is 'a little jealous'. There is no evidence of a direct personal or professional relationship between the interviewee and Snub Mosley.
